def encode_ascii(s):
    if isinstance(s, str):
        return s.encode('ascii')
    elif (isinstance(s, np.ndarray) and

        ns = np.char.encode(s, 'ascii').view(type(s))
        if ns.dtype.itemsize != s.dtype.itemsize / 4:
